newsitem.title: MEXICO: EU-Mexico trade hits $11.276 billion in 1996.
newsitem.headline: EU-Mexico trade hits $11.276 billion in 1996.

text.p: Trade volume between Mexico and the European Union (EU) totalled $11.276 billion in 1996, up from $10.086 in 1995, the European Commission delegation said on Thursday.

The European Commission said in its June report on EU-Mexico relations that Mexico imported $7.741 billion and exported $3.535 billion from the EU in 1996, thus notching up a deficit of $4.206 billion.
The report said the EU accounted for 6.1 percent of total Mexican trade in 1996.
Mexico's principal exports to the EU in 1996 were crude oil, engines with a capacity above 1,000 cubic centimeters, computer parts, chick peas, honey and beer, among other products, the report said.
The EU's principal exports to Mexico, meanwhile, included were powdered milk, vehicle parts and accessories, medicines, human and animal blood and textile machinery.
